title: henckelia koerperi
intro: Henckelia koerperi, commonly known as Toothache Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, helping to alleviate pain, reduce fever, and soothe digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, alkaloids, and flavonoids. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exhibit potential neuroprotective effects.
